_comment: Click-band alias-audit baseline. REFRESHED 2026-09-13 for the pickup-network refit (corner 2312 Hz -> 880 Hz on the drawn topology); previously captured at v0.5.1. Generated by `preamp-bench alias-audit --note <n> --velocity 120 --json` at 44.1 kHz host rate. Refresh rationale: hf_band_dbc rose +4.01 dB (note 72) and +3.42 dB (note 84) while max_step_up_db — the click-band PLATEAU metric, i.e. the actual aliasing signature — IMPROVED by 4.12 dB and 6.61 dB on those same two notes. More genuine harmonic content with less alias hash, which is the expected result of moving the pickup corner below the stimulus fundamentals. Note 91 is a wash (step_up +1.11 within tolerance, hf_band -1.69). The regression test asserts each metric stays within tolerance of these values.
